caution_findings.impact: Biofilm and immunomodulatory statements are background context only and are not promoted to direct mechanisms for these engineered peptides.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Enhanced antimicrobial potency is supported by increased membrane permeabilization in model bacterial and fungal liposomes; this is direct biophysical assay evidence, not a cellular target claim.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: KR-12 cyclic dimers, especially cd4 and cd4(Q5K,D9K)
mechanism_claims.limitations: Liposome leakage supports membrane permeabilization context; it does not prove a unique molecular pore model in live microbes.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR/CD evidence supports alpha-helical structure in membrane-mimicking environments and retained helical propensity after cyclization.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: KR-12, retro-KR-12, cd4, cd4(Q5K,D9K), and related cyclic dimers
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural context supports mechanism plausibility but is not by itself a direct antimicrobial mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Backbone cyclization improves serum stability relative to linear KR-12-derived peptides while dimerization increases antimicrobial potency.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Stability is a pharmacological property, not a direct killing mechanism.
